root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `is_codefence()` consumes up to three optional leading spaces, it must establish `i + 2 < size` before reading `data[i]` as the candidate fence byte. Otherwise an all-space short slice can advance `i` to `size` and make `c = data[i]` read one byte past the slice.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the pre-read length check that the vulnerable code performs too late. On the crashing witness, the selected `parse_listitem()` call reaches `is_codefence()` with a 3-byte probe of only spaces, so the space-skip logic advances `i` to 3 and the vulnerable read executes while `i + 2` is already 5. The fixed original stays clean by returning before `codefence_read`; the one-character `tail_backtick_first_space` perturbation still reaches the same selected call and supplies the genuine fixed-side witness with `slice_size=3` and `index_plus_two=2`.

nodes.state: At the sanitizer sink, the selected `is_codefence()` call still reads with `i == size`, so `c = data[i]` dereferences the first byte past the 3-byte probe slice.

For the selected definition-list item, `parse_listitem()` strips the `: ` marker before the fenced-code probe, so the probe slice `end - beg` is shorter than the original single-line definition body `end`.

edges.relation: The exact shortened probe pointer that `parse_listitem()` passes to `is_codefence()` is the same pointer later used as `data` at the selected sink-side read, so the stripped definition-tail slice reaches the out-of-bounds read unchanged.
